suggestions.change: Lower from day to summary and send one rolled-up 'posted' line per batch (e.g. social:done:<date>-<batch>) instead of a key per asset.
suggestions.why: Each post triggered a separate loud alert (3 stories at 11-03T06:22, 5 at 11-07 within an hour), all with today=silent, so they are done-notices that need no action.

suggestions.change: Lower prod:live, prod:full and ship:done to summary and merge sent/live/full for one number (163) into a single episode key.
suggestions.why: prod:sent:163, prod:live:163 and prod:full:163 are one episode on 11-04 to 11-07; live and full were loud while today=silent. ship:done:1.38.4 was loud too.

suggestions.about: open ledger: done/sent items since October
suggestions.change: Auto-close finished 'done', 'sent' and 'live' keys (prod:*, listing:done:*, safety:done:*, social:done:*) after they are reported, and close old social:remind keys once the post is made.
suggestions.why: Over 50 keys are open, many since 10-18, e.g. prod:sent:114 and listing:done:a8aa9a246359, though they only report completed work and need nothing from him.

suggestions.change: Dedupe the repeat sends within a run: send once per key, and update the existing entry if content changes.
suggestions.why: Between 21:24 and 21:28 on 11-01 each key was queued 4 times with the same content, so the ledger is noisy.

suggestions.change: Do not alert on these at first sight; log them and report only if still failing after the next scheduled check, or mark them as one daily recovered line.
suggestions.why: They fail and self-fix with no action from Dudu: ai:ceo-read quiet then fixed in 6 minutes, ai:guard fixed in 1 minute, zonea:slow lingered 3 days across keys 11-01, 11-02, 11-03.

suggestions.change: Use one key for the continuing slowness (e.g. zonea:slow) rather than one per date, and make the bot say when it ends.
suggestions.why: Three daily keys (11-01, 11-02, 11-03) were one episode, and the fixes for 11-02 and 11-03 arrived together on 11-05T06:21.

suggestions.change: Treat recalls, truth:recalls and truth:tow as one flaky-source episode; send the first failure at summary and escalate to day only if unrecovered after a few hours.
suggestions.why: recalls was loud 3 times (11-04, 11-07, 11-08) and each was fixed by a bot within hours; truth:tow was loud then fixed in ~25 hours; truth:recalls was loud on 11-08.

suggestions.change: Make a single failed run summary-level and retry first; escalate to day only after 2 consecutive failures.
suggestions.why: The guardian ran 8 times with 1 failure; on 11-04 it went loud and was fixed in 9 minutes, and on 11-08 it went loud again.
